batch.order: endpoint key SHA ascending within each language
batch.reset_contract: Exactly expectedN endpoint records byte-identical; only provably empty terminal EOF records may follow. No stripping/normalizing nonempty content.
batch.deformatter: Existing apertium-destxt once per endpoint, no custom implementation.

cost_estimate_seconds.basis: Linear extrapolation of64endpoint preprocessing and32endpoint batches, forward/reverse timing average. Bound includes roughly3x reserve; corpus token lengths vary, max60tokens/346UTF8bytes.

annotate.outputs: Raw deformat/morphology/contextual streams with endpoint offset/hash index; no duplicate full proof database. Estimated raw morphology+tagging8.0MB from measured554token reference and131705tokens.

join_evidence.outputs: Exact source/target form-span role references, unchanged old proof IDs/reasons, link strata, contextual alternatives, aggregate counts. Count prospective encoded bytes before writes; fail retained without dropped alternatives.

joins: Source exact displayed focus form; target each complete supported dictionary form inside retained aligned envelope, not all envelope tokens. Preserve envelope/alignment/compound/mutual-crossing reasons separately. Old candidate eligibility is never rewritten by this evidence pass.
